part.text:
Added Handlebars template engine and layout support. Summary:

- `src/templates.ts` — new `TemplateEngine`: loads `.hbs` templates from `./templates/`, layouts from `./templates/layouts/` (`{{{body}}}` placeholder), and registers partials from `./templates/partials/`. Uses `default` template/layout when a page doesn't specify one; falls back to the legacy built-in renderer when no templates exist.
- `src/generator.ts` — `buildSite` accepts `{ templatesDir }`; `loadPages` reads `template`/`layout` frontmatter and exposes custom frontmatter fields to templates.
- `src/markdown.ts` / `src/types.ts` — added `template`/`layout` to frontmatter and optional `template`/`layout`/`data` on `Page`.
- `src/cli.ts` — new `--templates <dir>` option (default `templates`).
- Tests: new `tests/templates.test.ts` (14 tests) plus CLI `--templates` and parseArgs cases. All existing tests still pass.
